'''R2-F2''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Core Set" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="A New Hope" /> though it was suspected of being a double agent. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was assigned to [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]],<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Astromech Droid Pack (Series 1)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCastroS1.asp}}</ref> who flew as [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Both Darklighter and R2-F2 were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when their [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighter]] was shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Biggs_with_R2-F2_-_The_Making_of_SW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|R2-F2 behind Biggs Darklighter in an X-wing]]
R2-F2 first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="A New Hope" /> It was first identified in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set|''Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game'' Core Set]],<ref name="Core Set" /> which was first released at GenCon Indy on [[August]] [[August 17|17]], [[2012]].<ref name="GenConRelease">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2012/7/2/launch-your-attack-run|text=Launch Your Attack Run}}</ref>

The [[1999]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]], conflated Biggs Darklighter's then-unidentified astromech [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with [[R2-Q2/Legends|R2-Q2]],<ref name="The Action Figure Archive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> an identical Imperial astromech droid that appeared on the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'' earlier in ''A New Hope''.<ref name="A New Hope" /> This error was repeated by the ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]'' toyline.<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack" />

R2-F2's color scheme varies as depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Empire]]'' and [[Star Wars: Rebellion (comic series)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] comic series.
